raw.details:
Introduction:

HackKro presents HackKro CodeByte 2026, a multi-round competitive coding battle hosted on the Unstop platform. Designed for both aspiring programmers and seasoned problem solvers, HackKro CodeByte 2026 tests foundational logic, algorithm design, and core programming proficiency. Compete nationwide, solve challenging problems, and push your limits.

Event Details:

Detail Information
Event Name HackKro CodeByte 2026
Organized By HackKro
Mode Online (via Unstop)
Eligibility Open to all Undergraduate & Postgraduate students (all streams & years)
Registration Fee Free (All Rounds)
Registration Deadline 30 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST

Stages and Timelines:

Round 1: Preliminary Assessment

  • Window: 05 Dec 2026, 02:30 PM IST – 06 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST

  • Format: 30 Minutes

  • Scope: Programming Fundamentals (C++, Java, Python), Data Structures, and Logical Reasoning.

Round 2: Java Coding Sprint (Qualified Participants Only)

  • Window: 07 Dec 2026, 03:30 PM IST – 07 Dec 2026, 11:59 AM IST

  • Access: Strictly for shortlisted candidates who clear Round 1.

  • Format: 2–3 Algorithmic Coding Problems (Easy to Medium) in Java.

Qualification & Progression Guidelines:

  • 100% Free Participation: Registration and participation across all rounds of HackKro CodeByte 2026 are completely free for all eligible students.

  • Merit-Based Shortlisting: Progression to Round 2 is strictly merit-based, determined by Round 1 assessment scores and submission speed.

  • Direct Round 2 Access: Shortlisted candidates will receive an official email/notification on Unstop with direct access instructions for the Round 2 coding sprint.

Rules & Code of Conduct:

  • Official Platform: All rounds and submissions must be completed strictly through the designated Unstop assessment and coding environment.

  • Integrity & Fair Play: Zero tolerance for plagiarism, AI-assisted tools, secondary devices, or unauthorized tab switches. Violations will result in immediate disqualification.

  • Account Verification: Single account policy is strictly enforced. Profile details (college, stream, graduation year) must match the participant's official identity documents.

  • Final Authority: In all matters regarding evaluation, shortlisting, and dispute resolution, the decision of Team HackKro remains final and binding.
